item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Zelenskyy made a surprise visit to Madrid for talks with Sánchez and Latin American leaders, while Ukraine continued strikes on Russian refineries ahead of a White House meeting and Italy prepared fresh military aid despite coalition splits. Russian forces set an Ozon warehouse ablaze in southern Russia, attacked a Ukrainian aid centre killing dozens, and exploited a cease-fire in Oleshky to move troops even as aid vehicles were hit; police body-cam footage captured a deadly Russian strike in Ukraine. Ukraine used drones to attack Ryazan refinery and injured four people with drone strikes in Dnipropetrovsk and Kyiv oblasts. Melania Trump is portrayed as a dark-horse diplomat on Ukraine, and the Starshield contract with the US is set to expire next year, according to a diplomat. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon due to the fighting. Israeli forces have also built a new road in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone. item.description:
